measurement_method: Read-only comparison: opaque silhouettes use alpha > 127. Because tool returns differ in size, the original guide alpha is scaled with nearest-neighbour in memory only to compute normalized silhouette intersection-over-union. No returned image is resized or edited. Low-alpha fringe pixels are counted separately. Exact-size alpha comparison necessarily fails for all 1254 x 1254 returns.
